body.x: iSenLab will showcase its ultraportablepersonal portable exhalation measurement sensor at CES 2019, the world'slargest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, from January 8 (Tue) to January 11(Fri).

Participating in this exhibition, iSenLabis the first company to lead the development of the world's first ultra-smallpersonalized portable exhalation measurement sensor. The product featuresacetone measurement in the exhalation, and it can be self-maintained by thesingle concentration gas injection with the automatic calibration function.
